{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit sweater: fitted, crew neck, long sleeves, hip-length, soft cream #F1E6D0, extra-fine merino wool

Maxi skirt: high-waisted A-line, falls to the ankle, deep green-teal #2E5B54, fluid matte crepe with a soft drape

Textured jacket: slightly tailored, single-breasted, hip-length with a straight hem, warm taupe-brown #6B5648, wool bouclé

Ankle boots: almond toe, block heel of about 5 cm, dark chocolate #3A2B24, smooth leather

Small clutch: structured, flat, with a slim chain strap, antique gold #B08D57, matte leather

Drop earrings: slim and delicate, polished warm gold #C9A24D, metal

Why this outfit works: The skirt is the long maxi she asked for, and the block-heeled ankle boots give her the 4–6 cm heel while staying steady through a long evening. The cream knit and textured jacket give the neat, polished look that suits a theatre in autumn, and the jacket keeps her warm on the way there and back. The deep green-teal echoes her grey-green eyes, and the cream and warm taupe flatter her golden hair and warm skin. The gold accents will catch the artificial light of the foyer and add a touch of evening glamour."}
